links.outcome: LLM response quality across clinical complexity categories using specialist-rated quality indicators
links.effect: Routine care scenarios scored 89.2% (95% CI 86.1%-92.3%) versus acute care 65.4% (95% CI 61.8%-69.0%); significant between-group differences (F[3196] = 47.3, P < .001).
links.quote: Routine care scenarios achieved excellent performance (89.2%, 95% CI: 86.1%-92.3%), while acute care situations showed concerning limitations (65.4%, 95% CI: 61.8%-69.0%).

unlisted_practices: Developing risk-stratified quality indicators for AI-assisted medical consultations

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance across simulated clinical scenarios of varying risk levels using expert review; it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
